readerCopy.body: A relationship, collaboration, offer, or money decision can make the next step materially easier to take. When Venus trines the North Node, connection and forward movement reinforce each other, bringing support through another person or through a clearer understanding of what deserves time and resources now. A useful introduction, partnership, or financial choice can reduce the cost of moving forward. The strongest support makes the future easier to live with rather than simply making the present more pleasant.
